gcp-compliance.control.sql_instance_sql_.reason: Framework-link re-adjudication (2026-10-11, re-verified against the benchmark recommendation): the upstream evaluator is defective (see upstream_defect) and is not claimed as executed; the control requirement is implemented by gcp.ports.sql_instance_sql_3625_trace_database_flag_on (see native_equivalence_verification).

upstream_defect.reason: The source requires trace flag3625off, which reverses its security effect: Microsoft documents that enabling3625 limits error-message detail for non-sysadmin users, and Cloud SQL supports the flag. Reject the anti-hardening condition while preserving source/framework lineage and the corrected3625on configuration check. Upstream title defect: the recommendation text says 'off' but its own rationale is that 3625 masks error-message parameters to 'help prevent disclosure of sensitive information' (the effect of the flag being on, per Microsoft); CIS GCP v2.0+ (6.3.6 / its query) corrected the requirement to 'on', which the native enforces.
